name: Trump International Tower Las Vegas
insider_take: This non-gaming luxury tower stands tall as Vegas's golden beacon, offering a serene escape from the Strip's chaos while keeping you at the heart of the action.
whats_special: This 64-story gleaming gold tower is actually a residential-style hotel with full kitchens and washer/dryers in every suite. Unlike typical Vegas hotels, there's no casino floor - just pure luxury living. The building's distinctive golden glass facade makes it a landmark visible from anywhere on the Strip, and it's one of the few hotels in Vegas where you can actually open the windows for fresh air.
pro_tip: Request a suite facing west for stunning Strip views, or east for dramatic sunrise views over the mountains. The higher floors offer some of the best panoramic vistas in all of Las Vegas.
dont_miss: The DJT Restaurant on the 64th floor serves contemporary American cuisine with floor-to-ceiling windows offering 360-degree city views. Take advantage of the heated outdoor pool - a rarity in Vegas high-rises - and the fact that you're walking distance to Fashion Show Mall, one of the largest shopping centers in the world.
pros: All-suite accommodations with spacious layouts and full kitchens
Non-gaming luxury tower offering peaceful environment
Premium location on Las Vegas Strip with panoramic views
High-end amenities including spa, fitness center, and rooftop pool
cons: No casino on-site for gaming enthusiasts
Higher price point compared to traditional hotels
